- scripts/ai_memory_lib.py:3040-3052, 3078-3084; scripts/memory_helpers.sh:585 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: Networked git authentication embeds the GitHub PAT directly in clone and remote URLs.
  WHY: The token is exposed through subprocess argv, `.git/config`, git errors, and workflow logs, and `tests/test_git_auth_hygiene.py:51-55` rejects the pattern.
- scripts/targeted_file_context.py:removed is_sensitive_target_path (formerly lines 147-167); normalize_path (lines 241-245); emit_context (lines 536-716) | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: Sensitive-path filtering was removed, allowing credential-bearing paths such as `.env`, `.git/config`, `.netrc`, `.npmrc`, `.pypirc`, and `.aws/credentials` to be read into model prompts.
  WHY: Plan- and PR-derived paths are untrusted, so the removed guard reopens credential disclosure to model-facing processes.
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:3460-3466 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: The “Run reviewer models” step still exports `GH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GH_PAT }}` and `REPOSITORY` to third-party reviewer processes.
  WHY: The linked requirement applies to all model-facing processes, not only the editor; severity was reported as major and blocker, so blocker is used.
- scripts/gh_helpers.sh:461-476; scripts/review_rb_judge.sh:1989, 2377-2380 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: `git_with_github_auth()` was removed while `review_rb_judge.sh` still invokes it for judge-fix and reissue-baseline pushes.
  WHY: The judge-fix path fails with `command not found`, while the guarded baseline path falls through to unauthenticated `git push` with `persist-credentials: false`.
- scripts/memory_helpers.sh:151, 180, 601, 624, 767, 883, 919 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: `_memory_git()` was deleted and networked memory git operations now use unauthenticated bare `git`.
  WHY: HTTPS `ls-remote`, clone, and push operations fail or silently fail-open when checkout credentials are not persisted; the token-in-URL alternative also leaks credentials.
- tests/test_git_auth_hygiene.py:95-98 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus]
  PROBLEM: The hygiene test still asserts the removed `_memory_git` call-site patterns.
  WHY: `test_networked_git_steps_use_ephemeral_authentication` raises `AssertionError` because all three expected patterns disappeared.
- tests/test_targeted_file_context.py:29-37, 679, 681, 741, 744; scripts/targeted_file_context.py:removed MAX_TARGET_PATHS, MAX_TARGET_PATH_BYTES, is_sensitive_target_path | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: Public exports `MAX_TARGET_PATHS`, `MAX_TARGET_PATH_BYTES`, and `is_sensitive_target_path` were removed while tests and downstream callers still import them.
  WHY: Test collection raises `ImportError`, and the removal is a breaking interface change; severity was reported as major and blocker, so blocker is used.
- scripts/targeted_file_context.py:emit_context at lines 536-716 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [moonshotai_kimi-k3, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: `max_bytes` no longer bounds rendered wrappers, markers, headers, summaries, or path count, and `max_bytes=0` emits non-empty output.
  WHY: The implementation violates the existing hard-byte-limit, path-count, and intentionally-empty-block behavior.
- scripts/label_helpers.sh:65, 118; .github/ai/label_contract.v1.json:168 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: `ai:merge-queued` was added to helper label maps but not to the canonical label contract.
  WHY: Exact helper-contract parity tests and contract-driven synchronization detect the extra label.
- .ai/.workspace_source_manifest.txt:173 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: The manifest lists `changelog.d/3965-security-pass-hardening.md` while the PR creates `changelog.d/3965-review-security-boundaries.md`.
  WHY: Workspace inventory and manifest reconciliation reference a nonexistent path and omit the actual fragment.
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:3889-3908 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: An empty or unavailable `post_editor_pr_state` is treated as a closed PR.
  WHY: A transient API failure sets `PR_CLOSED=true` and causes productive editor changes to be skipped; only explicit `closed` or `merged` states should do so.
- scripts/ledger_emit_substate.sh:173-219, 312-349 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The 1 MiB log-tail limit is justified by an incorrect O(n²) parsing claim and can omit usage summaries, while the `nan`/`inf` comment does not match the parsing behavior.
  WHY: Older runs can produce `token_values.total = None`, silently degrading telemetry.
- scripts/review_apply_fixes.sh:1-17 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The credential refusal guard only detects non-empty forbidden variables.
  WHY: A declared-but-empty credential variable bypasses the intended environment security boundary.
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:3895 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The post-editor recheck silently falls back to a pass-through `gh_retry()` when sourcing `gh_helpers.sh` fails.
  WHY: A malformed or missing helper removes retry/backoff behavior without an error.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
